title: thebasics:thebasics-handbook-title-scene-markers
text: Scene markers hold persistent roleplay descriptions without filling a build with large written signs. Craft one from any two loose stones, then place the small marker flat on the ground or against a wall. Writing and reading - Hold Shift and right-click a placed marker to edit its optional title, body, and presentation. - Choose Environmental description for in-fiction narration, or OOC notice for explicit production notes. - Look directly at a written marker to see its description over the world. The marker itself stays visually unobtrusive. - Break a marker to pick it up with its title, description, presentation, and author metadata intact. Hold Shift and right-click the item to read it. Editing follows normal land-claim permissions. Scene markers are durable world content, separate from temporary /envhere and !! cast messages and separate from local or global OOC chat settings. Padlocks The creator can sneak-right-click with a padlock to lock a marker, without reinforcing it first. Everyone can still read it. While locked, editing is disabled; only its creator or a server admin with claim access can break or unlock it. Sneak-right-click with an empty hand to unlock and recover the padlock. Picking up and replacing a locked marker preserves its lock and creator. Editing never transfers ownership. Normal land-claim permissions still apply.
